description_expanded: Lily Pad is newly added to our vacation rental management program. The ground-floor bedroom is currently being remodeled and will feature an updated bathroom along with two Full-over-Full bunk beds upon completion. Additional images and details will be added soon. Availability is limited, so secure your stay now or check back shortly for updates. Tucked beneath a canopy of mature trees in the quiet, lakefront Mar-a-Lago community of Seagrove Beach , Lily Pad i s a charming three-story coastal retreat designed for connection and comfort. With 3 bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms, and space for up to 12 guests, this south of Scenic 30A getaway offers a relaxed setting just minutes from the sugar-white shoreline. Complimentary bikes are included, making it easy to ride over to Old Florida Fish House for morning coffee or an evening cocktail, or to explore the scenic paths that wind through 30A’s coastal neighborhoods. And with wide public beach access nearby—no stairs to navigate—your days on the Gulf begin with ease. The second floor serves as the heart of the home, where natural light filters through oversized windows and an open-concept layout invites everyone to gather. Plush linen seating anchors the living area, flowing seamlessly into a dining space for eight and a fully equipped kitchen featuring granite countertops, stainless-steel appliances, and a deep farmhouse sink. Step onto the shaded balcony to sip coffee among the treetops or enjoy a breezy dinner as the sun dips low. The ground-floor bedroom is currently being remodeled and will soon feature an updated bathroom along with two full-over-full bunk beds, creating an even more comfortable and functional space for larger groups. Updated photos and additional details will be shared as soon as the enhancements are complete. Each bedroom is thoughtfully positioned across all three levels to provide privacy and flexibility for families or friends traveling together. The first floor offers a spacious guest suite with two full-over-full bunk beds, a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo, and direct outdoor access—ideal for kids or an additional family. On the third floor, two serene king bedrooms each include private balconies and en-suite bathrooms with shower/tub combinations, creating peaceful retreats to unwind after sun-soaked afternoons along the Gulf. A private gas grill invites easy evening cookouts at home, while access to the community pool offers another refreshing way to relax under the Florida sun. Lily Pad is located just a scenic 6-minute walk (approximately 0.4 miles) from the Eastern Lake Beach Access, where wide sands and the emerald waters of the Gulf await. Spend the day paddleboarding on Eastern Lake, biking to nearby beach towns, or exploring the local boat ramp for a peaceful afternoon on the water. With Seaside, Grayton Beach, and Rosemary Beach only a short drive or bike ride away, you’ll have easy access to coastal dining, boutique shopping, and the unmistakable charm of 30A living. Whether you’re cruising to coffee, stretching out on the sand, or gathering on the balcony beneath the trees, Lily Pad invites you to slow down and savor the rhythm of Seagrove Beach. First Floor: Guest Bedroom with 2 Full/Full Bunk Beds and Private Bathroom + Shower/Tub Combo. Second Floor: Living Room with Balcony Access, Dining, Kitchen, Laundry, Powder Room Third Floor: King Bedroom with Shower/Tub Combo, King Bedroom with Shower/Tub Combo.
